name: NFC (NXP PN553 through Huawei's NXP HAL)
description: sweet's NFC controller (NXP PN553, Qualcomm nq-nci driver, /dev/nq-nci) is driven by the HarmonyOS NFC stack through Huawei's own NXP HAL (libnfc_hal_impl_t001) and NCI stack (libnfc_nci_t001). The kernel provides the /sys/nfc attributes those read (chip type 'sn110u' selects the NXP libraries, device node, configuration names); the sn110 configuration files in chip_prod are replaced by sweet's PN553 one at boot, and the NFC firmware library is hidden so that the HAL never tries to flash SN110 firmware into the PN553.
